scope: Process-opt-in bounded worker wake/queue-progress/flip observations; not an idle CPU fix or proof of spin
logging_trigger: Only existing worker wake/processing, Sleep or Kill; no timer, thread, sleep or event changes

measurement_scope.waits: Completed wait calls, empty waits and wall durations; quick <=100us is not CPU spin proof
measurement_scope.readable_tokens: Counts per token for events existing handler already processes; ResourceBridge indices aggregate without IDs
measurement_scope.queue_progress_batches: process_queue returned true, meaning at least one descriptor returned; not a command or frame count; zero does not prove no commands because fenced descriptors may remain parked
measurement_scope.flip_pending_peak: Maximum pending vector length seen immediately before existing completion sweep
measurement_scope.flip_retired: Before-after pending vector shrink at existing completion sweep; not signaled-vs-expired distinction
measurement_scope.work_ns: Wall time processing per existing iteration; not task CPU time, GPU time or driver performance

source_applicability: GPU file matches tracked849e source; matched incremental builds reproduce installed native3f4dd and outer678fad before compiling the diagnostic pair. Exact source/tool/dependency pins and negative attempts are retained in build_validation; runtime remains unverified.
license: Inherited ChromiumOS BSD3-clause; source notice retained. Fixture embeds complete pinned LICENSE conditions/disclaimer.

mocked: event calls supplied by host scenarios; not complete native GPU worker execution
host_validation.scope: Host helper tests only; separate build_validation records actual matched native and adapter builds.

budget_exhaustion: After shared16record cap, checkpoint disables local collection and new opted-in workers decline collection; cap is never reset by worker recreation.
minimum_nonfinal_interval_scope: Per enabled worker; shared process cap still16 even across concurrent/recreated workers. Final Sleep/Kill record bypasses interval but not cap.
limitations: Diagnostic candidate only; not a CPU repair, busy-loop proof, frame/presentation count, GPU performance metric or previous-kill culprit identification.
Real guest workload/UI was uncontrolled during prior CPU sampling; sustained v_gpu CPU can reflect legitimate rendering.
Wall durations include scheduling; quickwaits alone do not establish spin. Queueprogress records used-descriptor returns; zero can also mean parked fenced work.
Finalrecord is attempted only on normal worker Sleep/Kill token handling, not guaranteed on errors/process death or after recordcap.
Matched incremental native and outer adapter builds passed separately; these host fixtures still do not execute the full GPU worker, driver or Android runtime. No clean-room AOSP rebuild claim.
Exact-token outer adapter and native pair are built. Image integration and physical acceptance require separate evidence; guest environment cannot enable native-host diagnostics.

build_validation.token_validation: Exact predicate source-pinned/host-tested; native prefix and environment key present once each. Adapter contains exact complete token.
